records.name: Quick Sleep
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing the Warrior from the Demon World story saga; also appears in TP Medal rotations
records.skill_description: The user lies down and recovers Health while the button is held. The user is defenseless during the sleep. Purification Majins can also recover Ki and Stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: Majin-only. High sustain value in safe PvE windows, but leaves the user exposed.

records.name: Saiyan Blaster
records.unlock_method: Conton City Patrol event: Cheelai & Broly All Out!, Teach Me, Broly! (Part 2)
records.skill_description: Creates a large green aura that overwhelms nearby pressure and lets the user immediately activate an Awoken Skill while the aura is active.
records.mechanics_notes: 400 Stamina cost. Its primary value is protecting the transformation startup window.

records.name: Gigantic Cluster
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 163, Broly the Invader; 40% Ultimate Finish slot
records.skill_description: Fires a spread of small green Ki Blasts. The number of blasts increases while an Awoken Skill is active.
records.mechanics_notes: Transformation-scaling spread attack suited to area pressure and multi-target PvE.

records.name: Remote Serious Bomb
records.unlock_method: Reach 80% Total Completion in Extra Story; also appears in TP Medal rotations
records.skill_description: The first activation places a Ki sign that seals the target's Awoken Skill. A second activation generates and launches the Serious Bomb while the target remains sealed.
records.mechanics_notes: Two-stage Ultimate. The Awoken seal is the defining utility component and the second activation supplies the damage payload.

records.name: Impulse Slash
records.unlock_method: TP Medal Shop limited-time rotation; 50 TP Medals
records.skill_description: Long rush Ultimate ending in a Consecutive Energy Blast finisher. When used with an Awoken Skill active, guarded hits drain additional enemy Stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: 32-hit rush sequence. Transformation synergy makes blocking the sequence increasingly dangerous for the defender.

policy: These records expand the research corpus without promoting them to fully verified status until independently reconciled against the canonical in-game/wiki source set.
